prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1426; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in at an intersection in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe where you were traveling and what the traffic signal looked like when you approached the intersection?

A: I was heading east on the main road and had a green light. I slowed a little because traffic was backed up on the cross street, but I didn't stop.

Q: What happened next?

A: A pickup coming from the north side ran through the intersection. I saw it at the last second and tried to brake, but it hit the driver's side of my car.

Q: Were you able to stop before impact, or did you have time to react?

A: Not really. I had maybe a second. The impact pushed my car sideways into the curb area.

Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness at any point?

A: No, I didn't black out. But my head snapped forward and then back, and my neck has been stiff ever since.

Q: Have you sought any medical attention since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They diagnosed whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some medication. I've also started physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any pain or limitations in daily activities?

A: Yes. Turning my head to check mirrors is painful, and I've had headaches most days. I've had to take time off work to attend appointments.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was following the signal and did everything I could to avoid the crash.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
